name: PDEBench
description: A large-scale benchmark dataset for scientific machine learning providing numerical simulation data across multiple PDE families (Burgers', advection, diffusion-reaction, compressible Navier-Stokes, and more) in 1D–3D settings. Designed to benchmark scientific ML models such as neural operators and PINNs against physics simulation ground truth, with support for both forward modeling and inverse parameter identification.
evaluation_method: model predictions vs. numerical simulation ground truth; relative L2 error / MSE typical
typical_sota_score: varies by PDE type and dimensionality; neural operators typically achieve <5% relative L2 error on canonical problems
reputation: NeurIPS 2022 Benchmark track; one of the standard reference benchmarks for neural PDE solvers and scientific ML; CC-BY 4.0, actively maintained
notes: Data stored in HDF5 format with dimensions [batch, time, x1, ..., xa, variables]. Dataset versioned (v8.0); hosted on DaRUS (University of Stuttgart). Distinct from non-physics PDE software benchmarks. GitHub available for implementation.
